rbi_failed_transactions.name: RBI TAT circular for failed transactions (20 Sep 2019)

cases.label: UPI payment to a shop/app: money debited but the merchant did not get the confirmation
cases.compensation: ₹100 per day if delay is beyond T + 5 days

cases.label: UPI transfer: account debited but the beneficiary account is not credited
cases.compensation: ₹100 per day if delay is beyond T + 1 day

cases.label: IMPS: account debited but the beneficiary account is not credited
cases.compensation: ₹100 per day if delay is beyond T + 1 day

rbi_failed_transactions.notes: T is the day of the transaction. Para 5: compensation is credited to the customer's account 'suo moto, without waiting for a complaint'.

dgca_flight.name: DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV (Rev. 4, effective 15 Feb 2023)
dgca_flight.extraordinary_circumstances: No compensation if caused by extraordinary circumstances beyond the airline's control, e.g. political instability, natural disaster, civil war, riot, flood, explosion, government order, strikes, ATC decisions, weather, security risks (paras 1.4, 1.5, 3.3.4, 3.4.4).

delay.meals_condition: Passenger checked in on time; free meals and refreshments in relation to waiting time (para 3.8.1(a)).

refund_or_alternate.offer: Either an alternate flight within 6 hours or a full refund of the ticket
refund_or_alternate.exact_text: When domestic flight is expected to be delayed for more than 6 hrs from the published scheduled time of departure or previously revised departure time (communicated more than 24 hours prior to original scheduled departure time), airlines shall offer an option of either an alternate flight within a period of 6 hours or full refund of ticket to the passenger.

hotel.offer: Free hotel accommodation when necessary, including transfers (para 3.8.1(b))

delay.cash_compensation_note: The CAR pays cash compensation only for denied boarding (para 3.2.2) and cancellation (para 3.3.2), per para 3.7.1. A delay by itself does not carry cash compensation.

cancellation.notice_two_weeks_or_more: Alternate flight or refund, as acceptable to the passenger (para 3.3.1).
cancellation.notice_less_than_two_weeks_up_to_24h: Alternate flight or refund of the ticket, as acceptable to the passenger (para 3.3.1).
cancellation.notice_less_than_24h: Alternate flight acceptable to the passenger, or compensation in addition to full refund (para 3.3.2).

compensation_by_block_time.rule: INR 5,000 or booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less
INR 7,500 or booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less
INR 10,000 or booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less

cancellation.also_applies_to: Passengers who missed a connecting flight booked on the same ticket number of an airline (para 3.3.2).
cancellation.airport_facilities: Meals and refreshments while waiting for the alternate flight, if already reported for the original flight (para 3.3.2, 3.8.1(a)).
no_compensation_if: Passenger did not give contact details (email or phone) at booking (para 3.3.3)
Extraordinary circumstances beyond the airline's control (para 3.3.4)

alternate_within_24h.rule: 200% of booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, subject to maximum of INR 10,000

alternate_after_24h.rule: 400% of booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, subject to maximum of INR 20,000

no_alternate_opted.rule: Refund of full value of ticket and compensation equal to 400% of booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, subject to maximum of INR 20,000

denied_boarding.condition: Applies when boarding is refused against the passenger's will because of overbooking, after presenting for boarding on time with a confirmed ticket (paras 2.6, 3.2.1).

baggage.note: Baggage loss/damage limits are not part of this CAR and were not verified today. The app only gives the complaint route.

dgca_flight.redressal: Complain to the airline first; then file on AirSewa; if still unhappy, any statutory body/court (paras 3.9.1-3.9.3). Each airline must appoint a Nodal Officer and Appellate Authority (para 3.10.4). The CAR sets no fixed reply deadline for them.

railway_refund.name: Indian Railways refund rules w.e.f. 12 Nov 2015 (IRCTC)

train_late.applies_to: Reserved, RAC and wait-listed tickets, journey not undertaken
train_late.measured_from: scheduled departure of the train from the station commencing journey
train_late.refund: Full fare, no cancellation charge or clerkage
train_late.eticket_condition: TDR filed online before the actual departure of the train
train_late.iticket_condition: Ticket surrendered up to the actual departure of the train
train_late.after_departure: No refund of fare shall be admissible

train_cancelled.eticket: Automatic full refund of fare on confirmed or RAC e-tickets, credited to the account used for booking; online cancellation or TDR not required
train_cancelled.iticket: Ticket can be cancelled up to 72 hrs after the scheduled departure of the train at any computerized reservation counter

railway_refund.booking_failed_money_debited: If amount is debited and ticket not issued, IRCTC refunds the entire fare and IRCTC convenience fee electronically; bank/card transaction charges are likely to be forfeited.
railway_refund.tdr_general: For confirmed e-tickets not cancelled or TDR not filed up to four hours before scheduled departure, no refund is admissible (except special cases such as late running).

refund_delay.title: Refund not received
refund_delay.summary: Your refund hasn't reached you yet
in_app_steps: Open the app and go to your orders
Pick the order and open its refund details
Note the refund ID or date shown, then tap Help to raise the issue

late_delivery.title: Order late or not delivered
in_app_steps: Open the app and go to your orders
Pick the order and check the tracking status
Tap Help on that order and choose the delivery problem

wrong_or_damaged_item.title: Wrong or damaged item
wrong_or_damaged_item.summary: You got the wrong item or it was damaged
in_app_steps: Take clear photos of the item, the box and the label
Open the app, go to your orders and pick the item
Choose Return or Replace and select 'damaged' or 'wrong item'

size_or_fit_return.title: Clothes don't fit
size_or_fit_return.summary: The clothes don't fit and you want to return or exchange them
in_app_steps: Keep the tags on and the item unused
Open the app, go to your orders and pick the item
Choose Return or Exchange and select the size reason

return_rejected.title: Return or refund rejected
in_app_steps: Open the order and read the reason given for rejecting the return
Save screenshots of the order, the rejection and any photos
Tap Help on that order and ask for the rejection to be reviewed

payment_deducted_no_order.title: Money deducted but no order
payment_deducted_no_order.summary: Money was taken but no order was placed
in_app_steps: Check your orders list to confirm no order was created
Note the transaction ID (UTR) from your bank or UPI app
Tap Help in the shopping app and report the failed payment

bank_route.title: Raise a dispute in your bank or UPI app
bank_route.instructions: In your UPI app or bank app, open the transaction and choose 'Raise dispute' or 'Report issue'. Under RBI rules a failed UPI merchant payment must be auto-reversed within T + 5 days, with ₹100 per day compensation after that, paid automatically.

denied_boarding.title: Not allowed to board
denied_boarding.summary: You were not allowed to board

baggage_issue.title: Baggage lost or damaged
baggage_issue.summary: Your bag was lost, delayed or damaged

train_late_not_travelled.title: Train late, didn't travel
train_late_not_travelled.summary: Your train is running late and you don't want to travel

shopping.title: Ask in the app
shopping.instructions: Raise the issue on the order inside the app. Save the ticket number they give you.

shopping.title: Contact customer care
shopping.instructions: Call, email or chat with customer care from the help page. Quote your order ID and the ticket number from step 1.

shopping.title: Write to the Grievance Officer
shopping.instructions: Email the Grievance Officer. By law they must confirm they got it within 48 hours and fix it within one month.

shopping.title: Complain to the National Consumer Helpline
shopping.instructions: Call 1915 or file online. Share the order ID, dates and what the company replied.

shopping.title: File a consumer case on e-Daakhil
shopping.instructions: File a case with the Consumer Commission online. Attach your evidence log.

bank.title: Raise a dispute in your bank or UPI app
bank.instructions: Open the transaction in your UPI or bank app and choose 'Raise dispute'. Keep the complaint number.

bank.title: Complain to the RBI Ombudsman
bank.instructions: File on the RBI complaint portal or call 14448, quoting your bank complaint number.

flight.title: Contact airline customer care
flight.instructions: Call or write to the airline. Quote your PNR and flight number, and keep the complaint number.

flight.title: Write to the airline's Nodal Officer
flight.instructions: Email the Nodal Officer with your PNR and complaint number. DGCA requires every airline to have one.

flight.title: Appeal to the Appellate Authority
flight.instructions: If the Nodal Officer's reply doesn't fix it, appeal to the Appellate Authority.

flight.title: File on AirSewa
flight.instructions: File your grievance on AirSewa (Ministry of Civil Aviation).

flight.title: Complain to the National Consumer Helpline
flight.instructions: Call 1915 or file online with your PNR, dates and replies so far.

flight.title: File a consumer case on e-Daakhil
flight.instructions: File a case with the Consumer Commission online. Attach your evidence log.

train_refund.title: File a TDR on IRCTC (refund) or complain on RailMadad
train_refund.instructions: For a refund, log in to IRCTC and choose Services > File Ticket Deposit Receipt (TDR). For any other complaint, use RailMadad or call 139.

train_refund.title: Complain to the National Consumer Helpline
train_refund.instructions: Call 1915 or file online with your PNR, TDR number and dates.

train_refund.title: File a consumer case on e-Daakhil
train_refund.instructions: File a case with the Consumer Commission online. Attach your evidence log.
